label_policy: MACHINE-ONLY reading hypotheses; no human, calligrapher, paleographer, or expert verified these labels. Confidence values are subjective and uncalibrated, not probabilities of historical truth. Labels are lowercase normalized word readings, not glyph-exact diplomatic transcriptions: long-s is normalized to logical s, case and graphic allographs are not distinguished, and uncertain historical spelling/abbreviation may remain. Original pixels preserve allograph forms, joins, and abbreviations. A one-shape-per-character renderer cannot model that distinction. Whole-word boxes are machine-selected from projection proposals, not letter cutouts or manual tracing; neighboring-line ink and pale-stroke boundary uncertainty remain. Below-threshold hypotheses remain recorded rather than relabeled or silently treated as verified. Generated texts are synthetic combinations of the admitted training alphabet, not claims about manuscript wording.
